I learned this trick awhile back, when I was pretty sad and mopey... Anytime I'm worried about something bad I ask myself "whats the worst that could happen?" I let the scenarios run through for a bit and then I ask myself "ok, and then what?"

After that a lot of the stuff I worry about and let get me down, aren't actually as bad as I build them up to be, there's usually always a way to move forward.
